QuestInfo.name: Black Book
QuestInfo.0: I obtained a peculiar looking book. The entire book, cover to cover, is black so I can't read it... I'm getting a strange vibe from the book. Perhaps #b#p2081200##k will know something about this book.
QuestInfo.1: #p2081200# said to go see #b#p2060100##k, the witch from the deep sea, to get information about this book. #p2060100#...? Why won't #p2081200# just tell me about the book himself? Would #p2060100# really know anything? I'm skeptical, but I have no choice...I must know more! \n\n#i4001107##t4001107# #b#c4001107# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: #p2060100# didn't know much about the book itself. However, she seemed to know #bhow to read the book#k. She understood the language, and agreed to tell me what it means upon my return.

0.0: I can feel your energy from here...What kind of question do you have, young magician...?
0.1: That book... has dangerous truth in it. Cold silence and sharp fear. The book has it. But that's what you may need...
0.2: This is a fork in the road for you. From a metaphorical point of view, you are staring into the dark abyss, my friend. You must choose your way. Stability without risk or dangerous power that may corrupt you...
0.3: Do you want to know more about #b#t04001107##k?

yes.0: Yeah... You want stronger power. Are you sure? Being number one means that everyone else is after you...
yes.1: There is someone who learned magic deep inside of the sea for a long time. #bWitch #p2060100##k. Go to see her. She will be able to give you the knowledge you seek. I hope you've made the right choice.

no.0: That's right. You chose stability. That can be a wise choice. Whatever you choose, I hope you don't regret it.

1.0: What has brought you here, so deep in the sea? \n... #p2081200#? Do you mean Gritto in the Forest of Priests? I wonder why such a noble magician wants to see this horrible witch...
1.1: No... I see. This mysterious energy. This is the energy from the book you have. Do you want to know about the book?

yes.0: Interesting. This cold and damp energy reminds of me of death... Hmm, I'm sorry but as #p2060100# I don't know about this book. However, I know #bhow to read the book#k.

item.0: Why do you want to see me? Go away if you don't need to see me. I don't like those who can enjoy the sunlight...
